name: Evaluate a Relational Algebra Expression on an Instance
recognitionClueHinglish: Do relations ke instance aur ek algebra expression di hai; tuples ki count ya result poochha hai.
whatShouldComeToMind: Natural join, selection, projection, union/minus ko step by step chalao.
generalSolvingApproach: 2. Join ke liye common attributes match karo.
commonTraps: Join ka key sahi na pehchanna.

name: 'For All' Queries: Division / Double Negation
recognitionClueHinglish: 'sab ... jo har ... ko' (customers who visited all hotels, own all brands, teams having every ...).
whatShouldComeToMind: Relational division (or NOT EXISTS NOT EXISTS).
generalSolvingApproach: 3. Ya X - pi_X((pi_X(R) x S) - R).
variationsObserved: Prerequisite courses ke basis par eligible students.
Division ko basic operators se likhna.
commonTraps: Division ki jagah simple join/minus laga dena.

name: Write / Explain a Relational Algebra Query
recognitionClueHinglish: Schema par requirement ke liye algebra likhni hai, ya diye expression ko English me samjhana hai.
whatShouldComeToMind: Requirement ko sigma, pi, join, minus me todo.
variationsObserved: 'More than once' = self join with different key.

name: Equivalence, Optimization, and Expressive Power
recognitionClueHinglish: Kaunsi expressions equivalent, optimized form, query expressible hai ya nahi, join ke max/min sizes, SQL SELECT vs sigma.
generalSolvingApproach: 3. Expressibility: fixed number of operators se nahi ho sakta to no.
variationsObserved: LOJ vs inner join equivalence under FK constraints.
commonTraps: Projection/selection swap galat conditions me karna.
